Diagnosis, Treatment, and Support 9Likes478ViewsAug 142025 What is hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) (https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-a...) ? Why is it often misdiagnosed, and what does effective care look like? We spoke to Jennifer L. Hsiao, MD (https://keck.usc.edu/faculty-search/j...) , dermatologist and director of the Hidradenitis Suppurativa Specialty Clinic at USC, to break down what HS really is, why a multidisciplinary team matters, and how new treatments, including FDA-approved biologics, are changing the landscape. We also hear from Athena Gierbolini (https://www.hs-foundation.org/athena-...) , president of Hope for HS, who shares her 14-year journey with HS, from painful trial-and-error treatments to finding life-changing support and specialist care. Join us as we learn how to advocate for better care and find the right resources to manage this complex and chronic condition. Credits • Host: John Whyte, MD, MPH • Guest: Jennifer L.
